```{r imports}
library(ggplot2)
```

## 1 closest

```{r data}
data <- read.csv('./weighted.csv')
```


### Mean time to reach by demographic group
```{r means}
black_mean <- mean(data[data$majority == 'black', ]$shortest_path)
white_mean <- mean(data[data$majority == 'white', ]$shortest_path)
```

```{r plot_means}
ggplot(data, aes(x = seq_along(shortest_path), y = shortest_path, color = majority)) + geom_point() + geom_hline(yintercept=black_mean, size=1, color="#F8766D") + geom_hline(yintercept=white_mean, size=1, color="#00bfc4")

ggplot(data, aes(x = shortest_path, y = n_cameras, color = majority)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method='lm')
```

```{r lm}
linmod <- lm(data = data, n_cameras ~ shortest_path + majority)
summary(linmod)
```

```{r lm}
linmod <- lm(data = data, absolute_increase ~ shortest_path + majority)
summary(linmod)
```
